ACCEPTANCE BASELINE STUDY — Enclosed three-compartment geometry with three pending lid-to-rear-panel hinge plans and provisional lid motion; measured axes, stock allocations, mounting, lid supports and fastening remain unresolved.

Planning review — 3-section storage banquette
3 seating sections. Seating: 3 enclosed for storage, 3 opening lids, 0 with backs. Seat height: 18 in; depth: 24 in. Closed body footprint in workspace X × Z: 72 × 24 in.
Assumption: This is an editable layout concept. Joinery, load capacity, bracing, anchoring, and finished tolerances still need design.
Assumption: Storage is enclosed with a bottom, front/rear and side panels. Panel joints and fasteners are not specified.
Assumption: Seat lids can be shown open for access review. The rear pivot is provisional; hinge selection, lid stays, pinch protection and wall clearance need design. Hinges and lid-support hardware are not specified or priced.
Assumption: The 3 sections are arranged side by side in one straight run; confirm whether you instead want an L or U layout.
Assumption: Casework and frame geometry use the selected actual stock thicknesses. Product identity and dimensions do not qualify seat loads, joinery, hinge/lid-support selection or current store inventory.
Review: Confirm table clearance, finished seat height/depth, cushion thickness, and access before building.
Review: Seat lids are modeled; hinges, stays, pinch protection, wall clearance and attachment details still need design.
Review: Long unsupported members and missing bracing/fasteners need review; this layout does not establish safe loads.

Study requirements to resolve:
material.frameLumber: Using generic 2 × 4 framing lumber dimensions for geometry only. Exact product, grade/species, exposure and installation suitability are unresolved.
hardware.seat-hinges: Select compatible seat hinges and determine quantities has not been matched and qualified for this study. Generic starter stock is dimensional geometry only.
hardware.lid-support: Select compatible lid supports and determine quantities has not been matched and qualified for this study. Generic starter stock is dimensional geometry only.
hardware.assembly-fasteners: Select actual assembly fasteners and determine quantities has not been matched and qualified for this study. Generic starter stock is dimensional geometry only.
material.caseworkPanels.installation: Dry interior cabinets, shelving and furniture using the selected BC sanded panel; nominal23/32 category uses reviewed .703-inch actual design thickness. Measure the purchased sheet and confirm panel stamp/grade before precision joinery; .703 inches is not .75 inches and manufacturer size tolerances still apply. This qualification is restricted to dry interior casework. Conflicting exposure descriptions do not establish wet-location, exterior, sauna or structural-seat suitability. The historical Lowe’s offer is retired; do not present it as a purchasable counterpart or import inventory for it.
operation.cut-schedule: Record the actual panel and lumber cuts remains a design/installation requirement; this geometry is not a ready-to-build kit.
operation.assembly-connections: Specify the actual attachment schedule and connection records remains a design/installation requirement; this geometry is not a ready-to-build kit.
operation.lid-installation: Specify hinge/stay holes, pivots and installation details remains a design/installation requirement; this geometry is not a ready-to-build kit.
design.load-and-joinery: Resolve intended loads, joinery and attachment details remains a design/installation requirement; this geometry is not a ready-to-build kit.
design.site-and-anchor: Resolve site/wall substrate, support and anchoring remains a design/installation requirement; this geometry is not a ready-to-build kit.
design.lid-safety: Resolve lid mass, support/hold-open action, pinch points and wall clearance remains a design/installation requirement; this geometry is not a ready-to-build kit.

They are not measurements of an Everbilt product or instructions for a real banquette. Only H001 is populated and selected while closed; H002/H003 remain pending. Leaf/knuckle fit, delivered screws, lid supports/stays, hold-open/pinch protection, fastening and closed-seat capacity require separate real review.
